From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Packaging questions for our pilot

Hi Elena — thanks for the usage sample, that helped. Quick answers and a proposed set of options below; happy to cover live.

Summary options (pilot-friendly):

1) Starter (pilot) — no commit, metered usage, includes basic KV caching and single-region Hosted runtime. Good for early experimentation.

2) Growth (recommended mid-term) — small monthly commit (50k tokens/day average) + 15% pilot discount for annual commit; includes priority scaling and 48-hr support SLA. If you upgrade within a billing month we pro-rate the new plan immediately and credit unused portion of prior commit as a time-weighted token credit.

3) Peak (reserved) — reserved capacity (Dedicated) with commit + steeper discount (25%) and guaranteed throughput/SLA. Best for predictable production traffic.

Downgrade / credit mechanics we propose:
- If you down-scope from Growth -> Starter mid-cycle, unused committed tokens convert to a one-time credit equal to 50% of remaining committed token value (applied to next invoice).
- For annual prepay cancellations we offer a step-down schedule: Q1 refund = 75% of unused, Q2 = 50%, Q3 = 25%, Q4 = 0%.

Pilot extension: we can extend the hosted trial to run through 30 Sep (two-week extension beyond your ask) provided we lock an optioned Growth quote by Aug 31.

Discount stacking: standard policy is one promotional discount allowed + commit-based pricing; for pilots we can apply an additional one-time "early-customer" 5% sweetener on the Growth tier to help close.

I've attached a concise pricing matrix and a sample wording block you can hand to procurement (redwood_pricing_matrix_v2.pdf). Proposed next steps: 30-min call tomorrow 10:00am PT?

Thanks — Priyom
